asarBaselineNote: The 1.7.0 production ASAR is 2767167 bytes, 191975 bytes (7.45%) above the 1.5.0 measurement of 2575192. The 1.6.0 package stayed inside the 5% band. Download and logical-size baselines stay at their measured values; the 1.7.0 macOS run passed those two checks and failed only on asarBytes.
